newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf may face lawsuits payout - paper.
newsitem.headline: Wharf may face lawsuits payout - paper.

text.p: Wharf (Holdings) Ltd could face HK$1 billion in potential damages payments from legal action against the group in Hong Kong and the United States, the South China Morning Post said on Tuesday.
A Wharf spokesman declined to comment on the report.
The daily said Wharf had said it would have to shoulder responsibility for about HK$400 million in damages awarded last month against Wheelock Marden & Co.
Wharf took over Wheelock Marden in the mid-1980's. Both unlisted Wheelock Marden and Co Ltd and listed Wharf (Holdings) Ltd are members of the listed Wheelock and Co Ltd group.

Wharf said last month that a Danish financing institution, ADS, had been awarded about HK$225 million plus interest due to omissions by a former director of Wheelock Marden to supply certain information to ADS. It said at the time that Wheelock Marden was considering the judgment with its legal advisers.

The newspaper also said the group was embroiled in a trial in the U.S. city of Denver, where a cable television management company, United International Holdings, was suing Wharf for about US$70 million (HK$541.8 million) in damages.
